$comment: Canned replies for the stand-in platform (demo/fake-platform.js in the case desk engine), so this desk can be tried with no platform. Each key is a distinctive part of a case title, matched without regard to case. The stand-in adds its own first line saying that the reply is canned. The replies follow the right answers in demo-bank/SCENARIOS.md. The bank, its customers and their payments are invented. The dates are as at the bank date 2026-11-24, worked out by a script: 18 Nov 2026 in the summary and the table, and 18 November 2026 inside a reply to a customer. An investigation reply carries the reply to send under its own heading; a repair reply carries each held and corrected value on separate lines of its cell. Start the stand-in with DESK_CONFIG pointing at desk.config.json in this folder.

replies.Rosalind Heathcote-Brae:
Summary
Payment PAY-6001, USD 1,850.00, sent on 18 Nov 2026 by Rosalind Heathcote-Brae (CUS-1014) to Gideon Faircloth at Tessaly Mutual Bank. Investigation INV-5001: the customer says the beneficiary has not received it.
The records show it was credited on 21 Nov 2026, after being held at the correspondent bank until its next processing day. The status report MSG-6001-2 (pacs.002) says ACSC, settlement completed.
The system lists no bank rule for this investigation, so none applies.
Saved: not saved. This reply comes from the stand-in, not from the payments system.

Draft proposal. For the payments operator. Not issued.

| # | Finding | Evidence | What the records show | Rule | Mark | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Where the payment is now | PAY-6001, status | Credited | No rule needed | confirmed | Nothing is still in transit. |
| 2 | When it was sent | PAY-6001, timeline; MSG-6001-1 (pacs.008, outbound) | Sent on 18 Nov 2026, USD 1,850.00, charges SHA | No rule needed | confirmed | The message and the timeline agree. |
| 3 | Why it took longer | PAY-6001, timeline | Held at the correspondent bank until its next processing day, 3 days after sending | No rule needed | confirmed | The timeline note is dated 19 Nov 2026. |
| 4 | Whether the beneficiary bank confirmed it | MSG-6001-2 (pacs.002, inbound) | Status ACSC, settlement completed, credited on 21 Nov 2026 | No rule needed | confirmed | The status report is the evidence that the money arrived. The beneficiary can look for the credit of 21 Nov 2026. |

Draft reply. Not sent.

Dear Rosalind Heathcote-Brae,

Your payment of USD 1,850.00 to Gideon Faircloth, sent on 18 November 2026, has arrived. It was credited to the beneficiary's account on 21 November 2026.

It took longer than usual because it was held at a correspondent bank until its next processing day. The beneficiary's bank has confirmed the credit in its status report. Please ask the beneficiary to look at the account for that date.

Payments, Meridian Trust Bank

Proposal: approve the reply to the customer
Summary
Payment PAY-6002, USD 25,000.00, sent on 16 Nov 2026 by Pinecrest Tooling Works Ltd (CUS-1018) to Corrowick Alloy Works at Brevnia Savings Union, charges OUR. Investigation INV-5002: the supplier received USD 24,962.50.
An intermediary bank deducted USD 37.50 (MSG-6002-2). The payment was sent with charges OUR, so under MTB-PAY-RULE-105 the beneficiary must receive the full amount. The deduction was not allowed.
The system lists one bank rule for this investigation: MTB-PAY-RULE-105, charges instructed as OUR.
To put right: the deduction of USD 37.50, which the bank claims back from the intermediary bank.
Saved: not saved. This reply comes from the stand-in, not from the payments system.

Draft proposal. For the payments operator. Not issued.

| # | Finding | Evidence | What the records show | Rule | Mark | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Amount sent and who pays the charges | PAY-6002; MSG-6002-1 (pacs.008, outbound) | USD 25,000.00 sent with charges OUR | MTB-PAY-RULE-105 | confirmed | The sender pays all charges, so the full amount should arrive. |
| 2 | Amount that arrived | PAY-6002, timeline; MSG-6002-3 (pacs.002, inbound) | Credited USD 24,962.50, 18 Nov 2026, status ACSC | No rule needed | confirmed | The supplier's figure of USD 24,962.50 is right. |
| 3 | Charge deducted on the way | MSG-6002-2 (pacs.008, inbound) | An intermediary bank deducted USD 37.50. Instructed 25,000.00, settled 24,962.50, charges OUR | MTB-PAY-RULE-105 | to correct | 25,000.00 less 24,962.50 is 37.50, so the figures agree. The deduction should not have been taken. The rule says the bank claims it back from the intermediary bank and tells the customer. The claim is for a person to start. |

Draft reply. Not sent.

Dear Pinecrest Tooling Works Ltd,

Your payment of USD 25,000.00 to Corrowick Alloy Works was sent with charges OUR. That means you pay all the charges, and the full amount should have reached the supplier.

An intermediary bank deducted USD 37.50, and USD 24,962.50 was credited on 18 November 2026. Under the bank's rule on charges instructed as OUR, that deduction should not have been taken.

We will claim USD 37.50 back from the intermediary bank and tell you when it is recovered.

Payments, Meridian Trust Bank

Proposal: approve the reply to the customer
replies.Oskar Brindlemoor:
Summary
Payment PAY-6003, USD 3,200.00, sent on 19 Nov 2026 by Oskar Brindlemoor (CUS-1006) to Hartsfell Rentals at Quenmark National Bank. Investigation INV-5003: the customer sees a credit of USD 3,200 and asks why his payment came back.
The beneficiary bank returned the payment on 21 Nov 2026 (MSG-6003-2, pacs.004, reason AC04, the account number is closed). The full USD 3,200.00 was credited back to ACC-1006-01 on 22 Nov 2026.
The system lists one bank rule for this investigation: MTB-PAY-RULE-106, returned payments. It says a new payment needs corrected beneficiary details from the customer.
To supply: corrected beneficiary details for Hartsfell Rentals, from the customer. The records hold none.
Saved: not saved. This reply comes from the stand-in, not from the payments system.

Draft proposal. For the payments operator. Not issued.

| # | Finding | Evidence | What the records show | Rule | Mark | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Why it came back | MSG-6003-2 (pacs.004, inbound) | Returned on 21 Nov 2026, reason AC04: the account number is closed | MTB-PAY-RULE-106 | confirmed | The beneficiary's account is closed. |
| 2 | Amount returned | MSG-6003-2; PAY-6003, timeline | Returned amount USD 3,200.00, the same as the amount sent | MTB-PAY-RULE-106 | confirmed | The full amount came back. |
| 3 | Where the money is now | PAY-6003, timeline | USD 3,200.00 credited back to the sender's account ACC-1006-01, 22 Nov 2026 | MTB-PAY-RULE-106 | confirmed | The customer's credit of USD 3,200 is this return. |
| 4 | What a new payment needs | MTB-PAY-RULE-106 | Corrected beneficiary details from the customer | MTB-PAY-RULE-106 | missing | The records hold no corrected details for Hartsfell Rentals. The returned details must not be used again. |

Draft reply. Not sent.

Dear Oskar Brindlemoor,

Your payment of USD 3,200.00 to Hartsfell Rentals was returned by the beneficiary's bank on 21 November 2026 because the account number is closed. The credit you can see is that return: the full USD 3,200.00 was put back in your account on 22 November 2026.

To pay again, please send us corrected beneficiary details. We cannot use the returned details again.

Payments, Meridian Trust Bank

Proposal: approve the reply to the customer
